weighting: Equal total weight per training take and known class within take, split equally across available views; no frame-level class weighting across test data
fit: Frozen X-VLA-Pt per-frame descriptors; fit only tiny linear sigmoid probes. No model/action-head/soft-prompt or robot-policy update.
negative_controls: Hand presence and fixed near-hand baseline; always not-held; time-only quadratic confound; seeded label permutation within each training take/view.
limitations: Intervals were visually reviewed at 0.5s by prior agents; not new human-verified contact events.
±0.25s boundary eroding may remove all known positive samples from short correction intervals. Report missing support, do not turn unknown into negative.
Known negatives mostly hands-away; performance may reflect hand presence. Unknown transition frames are unscored and require separate review.
Recorded sessions/category/camera share backgrounds. Previously inspected footage is exploratory; no broad contact, new-session or robot transfer claim.
No absolute time, future image, category, source/take ID, task label or crosshair input to deployable probes; clock-only arm is an explicit shortcut diagnostic.
